access.edition_or_version: Corpus of Tamil poems written c. 1907-1918 from French Pondicherry exile; Tamil journals banned in British India in 1909; the dossier does not name a consulted edition
access.language_used: en (secondary description in English; original-language prosody analysis not performed)

tone_mechanisms_observed: first-person-plural constitution of a 'we' that includes the listener
refrain-driven metres (Nondi Chindu) giving a collective, chant-adjacent rhythm
direct address to a present 'we' rather than narration at a distance
mechanics.context_note: Poet, journalist, and independence activist; arrested warrant in 1908, about ten years' exile in French Pondicherry; his Tamil journals were banned in British India in 1909 (dossier section E).
mechanics.translation_limit: Prosody claims rest on secondary description of Tamil metre, not on original-language analysis (dossier section E).
mechanics.verification_note: Tamil; journals banned 1909; verified via Sahitya Akademi reference and Tamil Virtual University; description only, no text reproduced (dossier section F).
